message: COLLEGE_EVENT: architectural_decision_three_arm_framework | {"date": "2026-10-12", "status": "DECIDED_AND_EXECUTED", "decision_id": "AD-20261012-001", "title": "3-Arm Comparative Architecture (Full Quant, Qualitative Moat, Hybrid Blend)", "specification": {"arm_1_full_quant": "ROIC-WACC EVA spread + FCF Margin + logistical exit (+15% gain / ROIC<=WACC), turnover 7.16%", "arm_2_qual_moat": "GICS-native driver routing + K=4 archetypes + Topic normalizer pillars + IV_moat DCF expansion", "arm_3_hybrid_blend": "Convex integration (70% Quant fundamentals + 30% Qualitative Moat) + StockTwits Hype P95 Crowding Suppressor", "common_structure": "85% active equity sleeve (Top 25 names) + 15% Short-Term Treasuries (BIL cushion)", "transaction_friction": "15 bps round-trip sunny day + 50 bps stress crisis"}, "rationale": "Harmonizes fundamental economic rents with qualitative competitive moat sustainability and risk suppression."}

COLLEGE_EVENT: architectural_decision_k4_clustering_archetypes | {"date": "2026-10-12", "status": "DECIDED_AND_EXECUTED", "decision_id": "AD-20261012-002", "title": "K=4 Cross-Sectional Behavioral Clustering & Archetype Multipliers", "archetypes": {"Innovator": {"multiplier": 1.2, "profile": "High R&D / developer velocity, clean safety records"}, "Compounder": {"multiplier": 1.0, "profile": "Moderate R&D, positive governance & insider conviction"}, "Hype_Trap": {"multiplier": 0.7, "profile": "High retail mindshare, low R&D, lack of institutional sponsorship"}, "High_Friction_Distress": {"multiplier": 0.5, "profile": "Depressed safety, high regulatory complaints / recalls (Immediate exit trigger)"}}, "normalization": "Median and MAD (x 1.4826) robust cross-sectional z-scores mapped via u = polarity * tanh(z / 2.0) into [-1, 1].", "thematic_pillars": ["rnd_innovation", "operational_health", "consumer_mindshare", "safety_regulatory", "governance_conviction"]}

COLLEGE_EVENT: architectural_decision_moat_dollar_valuation | {"date": "2026-10-12", "status": "DECIDED_AND_EXECUTED", "decision_id": "AD-20261012-003", "title": "Moat Dollar Fair Value Expansion & Volatility Scaling Engine", "formula": "IV_moat = IV_baseline * (1.0 + Pi_justified), where Pi_justified = MAX_JUSTIFIED_PREMIUM * MS_i * D_i * V_i", "parameters": {"max_justified_premium_cap": 0.8, "volatility_scaler_bounds": [0.7, 1.25], "durability_formula": "D_i = MS_i / (MS_i + F_i + 1e-4)", "customer_conc_handling": "Flagged >30% as graceful fragility penalty (0.30 * max(0, (cust_conc - 0.30) / 0.20)), not automatic demise", "alpha_spread": "Delta_alpha = Pi_justified - Market_Premium"}, "rationale": "Translates qualitative moats into dollar intrinsic value while dynamically penalizing high-volatility/speculative assets."}

COLLEGE_EVENT: architectural_decision_stocktwits_hype_regulator | {"date": "2026-10-12", "status": "DECIDED_AND_EXECUTED", "decision_id": "AD-20261012-004", "title": "StockTwits & Retail Mindshare Repurposed as Hype P95 Crowding Suppressor", "mechanism": "Omega_i in [0.50, 1.00] volatility and position sizing suppressor; never used as a long alpha buy signal", "trigger_conditions": "Retail message volume > 85th percentile and bullish sentiment ratio > 3.0 triggers crowding penalty", "effect": "Protects portfolio from euphoric retail tops and dampens drawdowns before mean reversion."}
